context: Asuka guides Ren on revising a draft.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: writing guidance; vocabulary (含ま/作ら/層/生じ/考えれ/箇所) in natural home.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: この文章、直す箇所はありますか?
lines.en: Are there spots to fix in this essay?
lines.style: earnest young student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 数箇所、誤解が生じやすいですね。
lines.en: In a few spots, misunderstanding easily arises.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: どう考えれば、直せますか?
lines.en: How should I think to fix it?
lines.style: curious young student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 読者の立場で考えれば、見えてきます。
lines.en: If you think from the reader's side, it becomes visible.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 結論に、意図が含まれていますか?
lines.en: Is the intent contained in the conclusion?
lines.style: thoughtful young student voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 意図が、うまく含まれていますよ。
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 良い文章は、丁寧に作られるんですね。
lines.style: understanding young student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: その箇所を直せば、より良くなります。
lines.en: Fix those spots and it'll be better.
lines.style: warm teacher voice, soft warm measured closing clarity throughout
